title: भारतीय फिल्मकाे दबदबा चिर्दै देशभर ‘बाटुलाे जून’ को विष्फाेटक ओपनिङ
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । अनमाेल केसी र प्रिन्सी खतिवडा स्टारर चलचित्र `बाटुलाे जून´ ले बक्स अफिसमा बम्पर ओपनिङ गरेकाे छ । आज रिलिज भएकाे यस चलचित्रले देशभर हाउसफुल भएकाे समाचारहरू सार्वजनिक भएका छन् । भुवन केसीले निर्माण र निर्देशन गरेकाे `बाटुलाे जून´ टिजर रिलिजदेखि नै अत्यधिक चर्चित र प्रशंसित बनिरहेकाे थियाे । चलचित्रका तीन गीतहरू पनि सुपरहिट छन् । चलचित्रले पेश गरेकाे अर्गानिक कन्टेन्टले दर्शककाे ध्यान तानेकाे थियाे । अनमाेल केसीकाे फरक लुक्स तथा प्रिन्सीकाे सुन्दरता र अभिनयले थप आकर्षण पैदा गरेकाे छ । प्रदर्शकहरूले पनि चलचित्रप्रति विश्वास राखेर `बाटुलाे जून´ लाई उच्च शाे दिएका छन् । देशभर २६२ भन्दा बढी शाे यसले पाएकाे छ । दर्शककाे उभार हेर्दा शाे अझै थपिनसक्ने देखिन्छ । गत साता भारतीय फिल्म `रामायण´ ले नेपालका हलहरूमा एकछत्र दवदवा बनाएकाे थियाे । त्यसलाई `बाटुलाे जून´ ले चिरिदिएकाे छ । ४ हजार कराेड लगानीकाे विदेशी चलचित्रसामु मामूली बजेटकाे नेपाली चलचित्र बकस अफिसमा पिसिनसक्ने जाेखिम थियाे । तर शाे संख्या र व्यापार दुवैमा `बाटुलाे जून´ ले रामायणलाई टक्कर दिएकाे प्रदर्शकहरू बताउँछन् । निर्माता सराेज न्याैपानेका अनुसार बिहान ११ बजेसम्म शाेमा `बाटुलाे जून´ले ६२ लाखभन्दा बढीकाे व्यापार गरेकाे छ । आज दिनभरिमा डेढ कराेड हाराहारी कलेक्सन हुन सक्ने देखिन्छ । निर्माता न्यौपानेले एफक्युब सिनेमामा हल भिजिटका क्रममा बक्स अफिस रिपोर्टको लाइभ डाटा नै देखाएका थिए । चलचित्र विकास बोर्ड र निर्माताको एक्सेसमा हुने लाइभ डाटा देखाउँदै न्यौपानेले भने, ‘अनमोलको करियरके ठूलो ओपनिङ गर्ने देखिन्छ।’ फिल्मले बिहान ११ बजेसम्मै ६५ लाखमाथिको व्यापार गरेको वितरक करण श्रेष्ठ क्रेजीको दाबी छ । ‎करणका अनुसार २०० भन्दा बढी सो हाउसफूल छन् । ‎ ‎’आज बिहान ६ बजेदेखि नै शोहरू हाउसफुल छन् । अघि ११ बजेसम्म फिल्मले ६५ लाख माथिको व्यापार गरिसकेको थियो,’ करणले भने, ‘आज एक करोड पचास लाखमाथिको ओपनिङ गर्ने देखिन्छ ।’ Kathmandu. Anmol KC and Princy Khatiwada starrer film `Batulo June' has had a bumper opening at the box office. The news has been made public that the film, which was released today, has been selling housefuls across the country. Produced and directed by Bhuvan KC, `Batulo June' has been gaining popularity and appreciation since its teaser release. The three songs of the movie are also superhits. The organic content presented by the movie has attracted the attention of the audience. Anmol KC's different looks and Princy's beauty and acting have created more attraction. Exhibitors have also shown faith in the film and have given high ratings to ``Batulo Jun''. It has received more than 262 screenings across the country. Judging by the audience turnout, it seems that the number of screenings can be increased further. Last week, the Indian film `Ramayana` created a buzz in Nepali cinemas. It has been overtaken by `Batulo June`. There was a risk that the Nepali film with a modest budget would be crushed at the box office by a foreign film with an investment of 4 thousand crores. But exhibitors say that `Batulo June` has beaten Ramayana in both number of shows and business. According to producer Saroj Nyapane, 'Batulo June' has done business of over 6.2 million till 11 am. It seems that the collection is likely to be around 1.5 crore throughout the day. Producer Neupane had shown the live data of the box office report during a hall visit at Fcube Cinema. Showing the live data accessed by the Film Development Board and the producer, Neupane said, 'It looks like Anmol's career will have a big opening.' Distributor Karan Shrestha Crazy claims that the film has done business of over 65 lakhs by 11 am. According to Karan, there are more than 200 housefulls. ‎ "The shows have been housefull since 6 am this morning. By 11 am, the film had done business of over 65 lakhs," Karan said, "It looks like it will open at over 15 million today."

फिल्मले बिहान ११ बजेसम्मै ६५ लाखमाथिको व्यापार गरेको वितरक करण श्रेष्ठ क्रेजीको दाबी छ । ‎करणका अनुसार २०० भन्दा बढी सो हाउसफूल छन् । ‎ ‎’आज बिहान ६ बजेदेखि नै शोहरू हाउसफुल छन् । अघि ११ बजेसम्म फिल्मले ६५ लाख माथिको व्यापार गरिसकेको थियो,’ करणले भने, ‘आज एक करोड पचास लाखमाथिको ओपनिङ गर्ने देखिन्छ ।’

Kathmandu. Anmol KC and Princy Khatiwada starrer film `Batulo June' has had a bumper opening at the box office. The news has been made public that the film, which was released today, has been selling housefuls across the country. Produced and directed by Bhuvan KC, `Batulo June' has been gaining popularity and appreciation since its teaser release. The three songs of the movie are also superhits. The organic content presented by the movie has attracted the attention of the audience. Anmol KC's different looks and Princy's beauty and acting have created more attraction. Exhibitors have also shown faith in the film and have given high ratings to ``Batulo Jun''. It has received more than 262 screenings across the country. Judging by the audience turnout, it seems that the number of screenings can be increased further. Last week, the Indian film `Ramayana` created a buzz in Nepali cinemas. It has been overtaken by `Batulo June`. There was a risk that the Nepali film with a modest budget would be crushed at the box office by a foreign film with an investment of 4 thousand crores. But exhibitors say that `Batulo June` has beaten Ramayana in both number of shows and business. According to producer Saroj Nyapane, 'Batulo June' has done business of over 6.2 million till 11 am. It seems that the collection is likely to be around 1.5 crore throughout the day. Producer Neupane had shown the live data of the box office report during a hall visit at Fcube Cinema. Showing the live data accessed by the Film Development Board and the producer, Neupane said, 'It looks like Anmol's career will have a big opening.' Distributor Karan Shrestha Crazy claims that the film has done business of over 65 lakhs by 11 am. According to Karan, there are more than 200 housefulls. ‎ "The shows have been housefull since 6 am this morning. By 11 am, the film had done business of over 65 lakhs," Karan said, "It looks like it will open at over 15 million today."
